article_manifest.original_title: FAMa : des positions de groupes armés ciblées à Abéïbara et près de Sévaré

article_manifest.title: Counter-terrorism: IATTC and DIRPA train journalists to deconstruct extremist narratives
article_manifest.original_title: Lutte contre le terrorisme : la CIMCT et la DIRPA forment des journalistes à la déconstruction des discours extrémistes
article_manifest.summary: The Islamic Military Coalition to Combat Terrorism (IMCTC), in collaboration with the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), closed this Friday, October 2, 2026, a training session devoted to the analysis of extremist and hate speech in digital media . article_manifest.title: Algeria sent fighter jets to Niger to thwart ‘coup attempt’, president says
article_manifest.original_title: Algeria sent fighter jets to Niger to thwart ‘coup attempt’, president says
article_manifest.summary: Algeria’s President Abdelmadjid Tebboune has said that his country sent fighter jets to Niger in late August to help thwart a “coup attempt” that shook the capital, Niamey. The confirmation came in excerpts from Tebboune’s interview with local media outlets that was broadcast on Saturday ahead of its full release.

article_manifest.title: Senou: A dangerous network of inoperable motorcycle robbers
article_manifest.original_title: Sénou : Un dangereux réseau de braqueurs de motos hors d’état de nuire

article_manifest.title: Algeria's president reveals behind the scenes of sending fighter jets to thwart coup attempt in Niger
article_manifest.original_title: رئيس الجزائر يكشف كواليس إرسال مقاتلات لإحباط محاولة انقلاب فى النيجر
article_manifest.summary: Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune revealed that his country sent fighter jets to Niger at the end of last August to thwart a coup attempt, stressing that his country's military move came in response to "provocations" to Algeria. In excerpts from an interview Tebboune gave to local media, the Algerian president explained that his Nigerian counterpart Mohamed Lamine Zine was on a visit to the country, and returned at night to his country, before a coup attempt took place.

article_manifest.title: Fight against terrorism: Captain (Navy) Ibrahima Sow invites the media to collaborate more with DIRPA

article_manifest.summary: The Director of the Directorate of Information and Public Relations of the Armed Forces (DIRPA), Captain (Navy) Ibrahima Sow, recalled the role of the media in the prevention of hate speech and violent extremism, on the occasion of the closing of the training organized by the Islamic Military Coalition to Combat Terrorism (IMCT) . According to the Director of DIRPA, the IMCT is an alliance of 43 states with a common Muslim religion, which are committed to organizing against terrorism and violent extremism in their regions .

article_manifest.title: Supply: A convoy of 643 tanker trucks arrives in Bamako under military escort
article_manifest.original_title: Approvisionnement : Un convoi de 643 camions-citernes arrive à Bamako sous escorte militaire
article_manifest.summary: A large convoy of more than 643 tanker trucks entered the Malian capital this Saturday, October 3, 2026, at around 7 a.m., after a night escort provided by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) . The convoy advanced all night under the protection of the military, kilometer after kilometer, before reaching Bamako at dawn. This operation is part of the continuous strengthening of the supply of petroleum products on the national territory .

article_manifest.title: Coup in Niger: Algeria denounces a "provocation" and reveals its military intervention
article_manifest.original_title: Coup d'état au Niger : L’Algérie dénonce une "provocation" et révèle son intervention militaire
article_manifest.summary: Coup d 'état in Niger: Algeria denounces a "provocation" and reveals its military intervention The Algerian President, Abdelmadjid Tebboune, strongly reaffirmed his country's unconditional support for Niger. During his regular meeting with the national press, the Head of State unveiled unprecedented details on Algiers' reaction to the recent coup attempt, described as an act of major destabilization .

The culmination of anniversary celebrations, they paid tribute to the armed forces and the military government’s achievements in Burkina Faso. One resident, Abdoul Rasmané Sawadogo, said military leaders have created an “ultra-modern army that meets expectations”.

article_manifest.title: 6 Burkina Faso: Night of the People's Progressive Revolution - The main achievements presented to the population
article_manifest.original_title: 6 Burkina Faso: Nuit de la Révolution progressiste populaire - Les principaux acquis présentés à la population
article_manifest.summary: The Night of the People's Progressive Revolution (RPP) was an opportunity to present the main achievements made during the four years of Captain Ibrahim Traoré. From the reconquest of the territory to diplomacy, via agriculture, health and culture, everything demonstrates that Burkina Faso is resolutely committed to its sovereignty and development . In addition to the tribute to the Defence and Security Forces (FDS) and the Volunteers for the Defence of the Fatherland (VDP), the first edition of the night of the People's Progressive Revolution (RPP) was a real moment of accountability.

article_manifest.title: Mali: more than 2,400 schools remain closed as insecurity disrupts new school year
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: more than 2,400 schools remain closed as insecurity disrupts new school year

The 2026-2027 academic year has been declared the “Year of Education and Culture” by President Assimi Goïta, but thousands of children are starting the year without access to their classrooms.

article_manifest.title: Pix of the Day, 30 September, 2026 - Across the world
article_manifest.original_title: Pix of the Day, 30 September, 2026 - Across the world

article_manifest.title: Crash of the Ouagadougou-Alger flight: Swiftair condemned

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso opens first gold refinery in push for economic independence
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso opens first gold refinery in push for economic independence
article_manifest.summary: Burkina Faso opened its first gold refinery on Monday, pushing ahead with plans to better organise the commercialisation of the precious metal in one of the continent's top producers. The west African nation is the continent's third leading gold producer, churning out more than 94 tonnes of the precious metal last year, according to the World Gold Council. But authorities traditionally struggle to control the informal gold mining sector, which has been blighted by jihadist violence and smuggling.
